title: Every new project skill and plugin screen — before and built
_comment_provenance: Only the project-tab Before pictures are historical master workbench captures from 2026-09-23 around 04:18 PDT (exact app commit not embedded in shot manifest). The drawer and marketplace Before pictures were captured 2026-09-26 from origin/master a4afcb8e3. All After pictures are current feature branch ea51cd80b, captured in the isolated workbench 2026-09-26. For novel states without a master counterpart, Before shows the actual parent Projects or drawer screen on master and is labeled parent screen only; no master popup/needs-setup/status is invented. See runs/every-screen-after/PROVENANCE.md for exact mapping and coverage.

steps.surface: Projects → Skills & tools
steps.path: Projects → a project → Skills & tools
steps.headline: The project has a fourth tab for its built-in plugins, installed plugins, personal skills and missing items. Keep it?
steps.changed: Master had Files, Conversations and Instructions; the built branch adds Skills & tools in that same tab strip, with per-project choices.
steps.notice: The project header remains. Before is historical master (September 23). Changes apply to new conversations; off skills remain callable with /.

steps.surface: Projects on a phone
steps.path: Projects → a project → Skills & tools at 390px
steps.headline: The new project tab and its grouped controls fit a 390-pixel screen. Keep this layout?
steps.changed: A fourth tab joins the existing compact tab strip; the selected tab keeps its name and the page scrolls vertically.
steps.notice: This is the shared renderer at phone width, not a verified Android app build.
steps.risk: Before is historical master from September 23.

steps.surface: Installed plugin details
steps.path: Projects → a project → Skills & tools → Research Kit chevron
steps.headline: Research Kit expands to show each skill and its tool connection, with separate choices. Keep it?
steps.changed: The installed plugin row reveals Web digest, Citation check and Research sources; the plugin master switch can pause its parts.
steps.notice: These are sample workbench items; master had no installed-plugin group in a project.

steps.surface: Installed plugin details on a phone
steps.path: Projects → Skills & tools → Research Kit chevron at 390px
steps.headline: The installed plugin's individual items remain reachable at phone width. Keep this view?
steps.changed: The expanded rows stack under the plugin, with status text and switches rather than a separate screen.
steps.notice: This is the workbench renderer at 390px, not an Android installation.

steps.surface: Personal skills and missing items
steps.path: Projects → a project → Skills & tools → scroll down
steps.headline: The bottom of the project tab separates personal skills from items needing setup on this device. Keep it?
steps.changed: Journal companion has a project switch; Writing helper and Linear are saved choices that need local setup.
steps.notice: The missing rows are not usable yet; Set up here explains the next step.

steps.surface: Personal skills and missing items on a phone
steps.path: Projects → Skills & tools → scroll to Needs setup at 390px
steps.headline: The personal and needs-setup rows remain accessible at phone width. Keep this layout?
steps.changed: The same controls stack and wrap at 390px without needing a second page.
steps.notice: This is a narrow desktop workbench capture, not an Android runtime check.

steps.surface: Turning on a tool connection
steps.path: Projects → Skills & tools → turn on Research Kit
steps.headline: Turning on a plugin with an outside-service connection asks for confirmation first. Is this clear?
steps.changed: The popup names Research sources and explains that new conversations may reach outside services without another prompt.
steps.notice: Cancel keeps the switch off; master had no per-project risk confirmation.

steps.surface: Set up a missing personal skill
steps.path: Projects → Skills & tools → Writing helper → Set up here
steps.headline: For a missing personal skill, does this popup offer the right two setup paths?
steps.changed: It explains that personal skill files do not sync yet, then offers Ask assistant or Choose skill file.
steps.notice: Master had neither the missing-item row nor this popup.

steps.surface: Set up a missing personal skill on a phone
steps.path: Projects → Skills & tools → Writing helper → Set up here at 390px
steps.headline: The missing-skill setup popup and both actions fit at phone width. Keep it?
steps.changed: The explanation and buttons fit in a narrow prompt rather than expanding the row.
steps.notice: This is the shared renderer at 390px, not an Android app verification.

steps.surface: Set up a missing tool connection
steps.path: Projects → Skills & tools → Linear → Set up here
steps.headline: For a missing tool connection, does the popup make the next step clear?
steps.changed: The explanation says its connection and sign-in stay on the original device; this popup offers Ask assistant, not Choose skill file.
steps.notice: Master had neither a missing tool-connection row nor this popup.

steps.surface: Set up a missing tool connection on a phone
steps.path: Projects → Skills & tools → Linear → Set up here at 390px
steps.headline: The tool-connection setup popup stays legible at phone width. Keep it?
steps.changed: Only the relevant Ask assistant action is shown in the compact popup.
steps.notice: This is a phone-width workbench capture, not an Android runtime check.

steps.surface: Skills drawer
steps.path: Chat → Browse skills
steps.headline: The drawer labels installed skills Automatic or Manual use and shows missing items as unavailable. Keep it?
steps.changed: Master showed skills without per-conversation availability; the built drawer adds color-coded chips and needs-setup cards.
steps.notice: Automatic is included in this conversation; Manual use is callable with /. Workbench sample only; native enforcement is not shown.

steps.surface: Skills drawer on a phone
steps.path: Chat → Browse skills at 390px
steps.headline: The new availability labels fit the phone-width drawer. Keep them?
steps.changed: The scrolled phone-width drawer shows Manual use and Automatic chips beside the source badges. Missing items appear farther down.
steps.notice: This is the shared renderer at 390px, not an Android app installation.

steps.surface: Missing item in the skills drawer
steps.path: Chat → Browse skills → scroll to Writing helper
steps.headline: Does the dimmed Writing helper card clearly signal that this skill cannot run here yet?
steps.changed: The unavailable card explains that this project's choice is saved but its skill file is absent here.
steps.notice: Pressing the card routes to its exact setup row in Projects.

steps.surface: Changing project settings during a conversation
steps.path: Chat → Browse skills after a project setting changes
steps.headline: Does the drawer's project-settings-changed note explain why this conversation's availability has not changed?
steps.changed: A quiet line says changes apply in your next new conversation; this capture simulates that backend flag in the isolated workbench.
steps.notice: Master has no project choices or this note; the capture does not demonstrate an actual conversation change.

steps.surface: Navigate to the missing item's row
steps.path: Chat → Browse skills → Writing helper Unavailable
steps.headline: Does pressing Unavailable land you on Writing helper's exact row in Projects?
steps.changed: The drawer closes, opens Skills & tools for that project and scrolls the named row into view.
steps.notice: The screenshot shows the destination; the verified capture checked that the row is fully on-screen.

steps.surface: Marketplace plugin details
steps.path: Marketplace → Inbox → Install
steps.headline: After installing from the detail page, the same window offers per-project setup. Keep this flow?
steps.changed: Master's Inbox details offered Install but no project choices. The built flow opens Set up Inbox, with every project's automatic use initially off.
steps.notice: You can finish later; installing does not automatically switch it on in your projects.
steps.risk: Before was captured on September 26 master; both installs are simulated in separate workbenches.

steps.surface: Marketplace plugin details on a phone
steps.path: Marketplace → Inbox → Install at 390px
steps.headline: The post-install project choices fit the phone-width marketplace panel. Keep this flow?
steps.changed: After Install, the setup panel replaces the detail view and keeps the Done action reachable.
steps.notice: The project and its plugin parts can expand; this is a narrow workbench capture, not Android.

steps.surface: Marketplace grid card install
steps.path: Marketplace → Explore everything → Inbox card → Install
steps.headline: Installing Inbox directly from a grid card also opens project setup. Keep that entry point?
steps.changed: On master the grid card only installs. On the built branch its install action opens Set up Inbox with project choices.
steps.notice: Both images come from workbench captures; the built shot used the grid card, not the detail-page Install.

steps.surface: Marketplace grid card install on a phone
steps.path: Marketplace → Explore everything → Inbox card → Install at 390px
steps.headline: The phone-width grid card's Install action opens the same setup panel. Keep it?
steps.changed: The compact list card leads directly to Set up Inbox after the simulated install.
steps.notice: This tests a 390px workbench viewport, not the Android app.
